effectSummary.ko: 8초간 이동속도가 20% 증가합니다. 이전 흔적에서 1.5m 이동할 때 그 자리에 잔상을 남깁니다. 동시 2개, 총 8개까지입니다. 기본 공격 또는 A01·A02·A07·A08·A13·A14 직접 적중 시 시야·사거리 10m가 유효한 잔상 하나가 그 자리에서 D60% 암흑 화살을 쏩니다. 시전당·초당 한 번이며 제자리에서는 새 잔상이 생기지 않습니다.
effectSummary.en: Gain 20% movement speed for 8s. Moving 1.5m from the previous trail anchor leaves an afterimage there, up to 2 at once and 8 total. On a direct hit of BASIC, A01, A02, A07, A08, A13 or A14, consume one afterimage with a clear shot within 10m to fire a D60% secondary shadow arrow from that location. Once per cast and second; standing still creates no new images.

productionConcept: ULTIMATE: a dominant shadowy hooded ranger draws a spectral bow while a single imposing violet-black winglike echo sweeps forward behind the shoulders. One bright dark-violet arrow and its trailing shadow double aim at the same direction. Dense heroic central silhouette conveys mobile pursuit and echo damage, no scenery.
prompt: Create one square HELLSCRIPT dark fantasy RPG skill icon for A18 (Ranger). Main subject: one dark hooded archer stepping sideways with two translucent violet archer silhouettes left behind, one bright violet arrow fired from a previous silhouette, movement leaves shooting afterimages. Painterly premium game ability icon, strong sculpted silhouette, weathered iron and focused luminous magical accent, restrained dark desaturated colors, dramatic readable highlights. Composition must remain unmistakable at 64 by 64 pixels. One isolated centered icon subject fills about 85 percent of the square; no decorative circular medallion, no border, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no additional unrelated weapons. Deliver a transparent PNG with preserved native alpha. All surrounding space and internal empty spaces fully transparent; no scenery, no solid backdrop, no checkerboard, no floor, no frame, no unwanted shadow. Keep wispy effects minimal and clean at small size. Do not add an opaque background.
